description.zh: 数据源ID，数据源的唯一标识符。
数据源分享到的目标项目空间ID，不支持分享到本项目。
description.en: The ID of the workspace to which the data source is shared. You cannot share the data source to the workspace with which the data source is associated.

title.zh: 查询数据源分享规则列表

descriptions.zh:
1. 需要购买DataWorks基础版及以上版本才能使用。
2. 操作人想要查看一个数据源的分享规则，该数据源位于A空间，则操作人需要在A空间具有数据源分享的权限点。需要在DataWorks项目空间中具有如下至少一种角色：
- 租户所有者、租户管理员、空间管理员、项目所有者
descriptions.en:
1. This operation is available for all DataWorks editions.

2. To query the sharing rules of a data source associated with a workspace, you must have the data source sharing permissions in that workspace. You must have one of the following roles in DataWorks:

- Tenant Owner, Tenant Administrator, Workspace Administrator, and Workspace Owner
